sql.if: and (v.title like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or v.summary like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or v.field like concat('%', #{q}, '%'))
and v.deadline is not null and v.deadline <= #{deadlineBefore}
and exists (select 1 from nad_scholarship_level sl where sl.scholarship_id = v.id and sl.level in #{lv})
and exists (select 1 from nad_scholarship_category_link cl join nad_scholarship_category c on c.id = cl.category_id where cl.scholarship_id = v.id and c.code in #{cc})
and exists (select 1 from nad_scholarship_intake si where si.scholarship_id = v.id and si.term in #{it})

choose.when: order by v.deadline is null, v.deadline asc, v.id desc
order by v.published_at desc, v.id desc
order by v.title asc, v.id asc
choose.otherwise: order by v.is_featured desc, v.is_hot desc, v.published_at desc, v.id desc

select v.funding_model as value, count(*) as count from v_scholarship_student v

mapper.select: select level from nad_scholarship_level where scholarship_id = #{scholarshipId} order by level
select id, code, name from nad_scholarship_category order by sort_order, code
select c.id, c.code, c.name from nad_scholarship_category_link cl join nad_scholarship_category c on c.id = cl.category_id where cl.scholarship_id = #{scholarshipId} order by c.sort_order
